scientific_integrity: The inequality \(a(N)>N\) is certified by a finite exact integer computation using inclusion-exclusion for ordered factorizations, with independent small-signature checks against the defining recursion. No floating-point comparison is used.
scientific_limitations: This proves only the \(k=3\) case of Fink's prime-avoidance conjecture. The witness is not claimed minimal, and no conclusion is made for arbitrary \(k\).
title: An explicit ample number coprime to \(30\) proves the \(k=3\) case of Fink's conjecture
